item.name: 13 - Finance
item.description:
Invoices, payment receipts, fee plans, Stripe Checkout Session creation, and checkout status verification.

NOTE ON WEBHOOK TESTING:
Stripe Webhooks (POST /api/finance/stripe/webhook) require genuine cryptographic signature headers (`stripe-signature`) generated with `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. They cannot be tested with fabricated Postman POST requests. Use the official Stripe CLI to forward signed test webhooks:
```bash
stripe listen --forward-to http://localhost:3000/api/finance/stripe/webhook
```
